%1$s can encrypt chats with either of two OMEMO versions.

Legacy OMEMO is the audited, widely adopted version that every OMEMO app supports. It is the recommended default.

PQ OMEMO2 adds post-quantum protection and encrypted metadata, but it is still experimental: the protocol is under active development and only a few apps implement it, so contacts on other or older apps will not be able to read those messages.

Which one should chats use by default?
